$comment: The guided walkthrough as data, run by src/guided/GuidedPath.svelte (step logic: src/guided/steps.js). Built around the North Star (docs/PRD.md): think in relationships, not pitches; your ear does the work and the tool shortens the feedback loop. Core first, extras after. It starts on its own on a first visit, in the dock's strip, and teaches the real interface: no button does a step for the viewer. Each step names one thing to do and spotlights the real control (`target`: a violet ring that pulses gently, scrolled into view), and advances when the app shows it done. The strip also has Back, Next (move on without doing it) and Restart (step 1 with the tune fresh), and 'Leave lesson' ('Finish' on the last); a step reached with Back or Next waits for the viewer even if it's already done. With another song open on a step about the tune, the strip offers 'Back to' the tune. `status` is for maintainers and isn't shown. Fields: id, title (2–4 words), `line` (one action, marked [[like this]] and shown in the accent color, exactly once; about 16 words at most), `done` (what the action produces; a step already done when the walkthrough moves on to it is skipped), optional `hint` (shown while its `when` holds and `done` doesn't), `target`, and `sendOff` on the closing line (not a step: Finish ends it, and doing its action finishes too). Conditions: songLoaded {song} (loaded during this run), played (Play pressed since the song loaded), keyChosen {tonic, mode}, chordAt {bar, beat, numeral}, degrees {degrees} (the last notes played on the number row or the piano, as scale degrees), fact {fact}: keyCommitted (any home chosen), transposed, recordStarted (FACTS in steps.js), or a name in pageFacts (true while its selector matches): tutorAsked is a review or question sent. Pressing the button is the viewer's action; whether the tutor can answer isn't theirs to control, so the review step never waits for a reply. Optional `lesson` (a recorded lesson id, content/lessons/plan.json): a request of the mode that lesson was recorded for (the review step: Review my chords) replays it instead of calling the live tutor, so the step answers anyone, with no access code and no cost; the server plays the committed sample reply for that mode until the lesson is recorded. A request of the other mode never replays it. Targets: song {song} (its card on the welcome, else the song select), button {within, name}, element {selector}, note {bar, beat} (its notehead), keys {codes} (the piano keys those computer keys play). Bars and beats are checked against the song by tests/guided/steps.test.js. Wording by Claude, Oct 7, 2026, delegated by Matthew; the review step and navigation revised the same day (DECISIONS.md).

steps.title: Open a tune
steps.line: [[Load Ode to Joy]]; its key starts hidden, so your ear finds it.

steps.title: Hear it
steps.line: [[Press Play]] and hum along; notice where it wants to stop.

steps.title: Find home by ear
steps.line: [[Pick the home the tune settles on]]; Help me find it plays each choice under it.

hint.text: Does it settle there? [[Press Check it by ear]] and try each chord again.

steps.title: Count from home
steps.line: [[Play 3 3 4 5]] on the number row or piano: the tune, counted from home.

steps.title: A question at bar 4
steps.line: [[Put V under the long note in bar 4]]; hear it ask a question.

steps.title: Now let it land
steps.line: [[Try vi, then I, under the last note]]; keep the one that lands.

steps.title: Get a review
steps.line: [[Press Review my chords]] for a read of your chart, and what else to try.

steps.title: Same tune, any key
steps.line: [[Play it in another key]]: new sound, same numbers.
